Sofia, the lamp delivery at door 6 was on Pellow (Pellow Home Living, your retail account). I posted this as a reply to your message in #coastal-team.

The answer comes from your February 17 thread with Kwame. In that thread, you said the "PHL" rows with the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments are Pellow. You said the Gulf Coast terminal rows are Pellucid Harbor Logistics. Kwame then confirmed the door 6 lamp delivery was on your retail account and not the container pickup.
